bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to real property; temporarily exempting plats in St. Louis County from certifications related to taxes.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ST. LOUIS COUNTY; EXEMPTION FROM PLAT CERTIFICATION. +]

[+(a) Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, St. Louis County is exempt from the requirements under Minnesota Statutes, sections 505.021, subdivision 9, paragraph (d), and 505.04, that each plat contain a certification from a county official that the current year's taxes have been paid and there are no delinquent taxes owed. +]

[+(b) This section expires October 1, 2026. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to real property; temporarily exempting plats in St. Louis County from certifications related to taxes.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ST. LOUIS COUNTY; EXEMPTION FROM PLAT CERTIFICATION.

(a) Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, St. Louis County is exempt from the requirements under Minnesota Statutes, sections 505.021, subdivision 9, paragraph (d), and 505.04, that each plat contain a certification from a county official that the current year's taxes have been paid and there are no delinquent taxes owed.

(b) This section expires October 1, 2026.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
